rules.name: SQL queries should not be built from concatenated input
rules.description: Building SQL with string concatenation lets attackers change the query structure. Use placeholders and pass values separately to database/sql, sqlx or pgx.
rules.noncompliant:
q := "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'"
rows, err := db.Query(q)
rules.compliant:
rows, err := db.Query(
    "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1", email)

rules.name: Credentials and API keys should not be hard-coded
rules.description: Detects high-entropy strings and known key formats (AWS, Stripe, GitHub, Slack) assigned to fields, constants or properties.

rules.name: JWTs should be verified, not just decoded
rules.description: jwt.decode() and similar helpers return claims without checking signature, issuer or expiry. Use verify() with a pinned algorithm.

rules.name: HTML passed to dangerouslySetInnerHTML should be sanitized
rules.description: Flags dangerouslySetInnerHTML and innerHTML assignments whose value is not passed through a configured sanitizer.

rules.name: yaml.load should use SafeLoader
rules.description: yaml.load with Loader, UnsafeLoader or FullLoader can instantiate arbitrary Python objects from untrusted input.

rules.name: unwrap() and expect() should not be used in library request paths
rules.description: Panics abort the current task or thread. In functions that already return Result, propagate the error with ? instead.

rules.name: Promises should be awaited or explicitly handled
rules.description: A promise that is neither awaited, returned nor given a rejection handler turns failures into unhandled rejections.

rules.name: Returned errors should be checked
rules.description: Ignoring an error return hides I/O, encoding and network failures.

rules.name: Exceptions should not be caught with a bare or broad except
rules.description: Catching Exception hides programming errors and makes fallbacks fire for the wrong reasons.

rules.name: Cognitive complexity of methods should not be too high
rules.description: Counts nesting, breaks in linear flow and boolean sequences. High scores correlate with defect density and slow reviews.

rules.name: unsafe blocks should carry a // SAFETY: comment
rules.description: Every unsafe block should state the invariant that makes it sound, so reviewers can check it.

rules.name: Blocks of code should not be duplicated
rules.description: Per-language duplicate block detection. Disabled in favor of the cross-language duplication metric.
